subject.title: fix(ui): block agent-authored widget command prompts

question: Should agent-authored widget prompts permanently reject both `/` and `!` host-command prefixes, even where an existing app may have relied on prompting a user with that text?
rationale: The patch deliberately fails closed for a previously accepted widget input class; repository policy treats stricter validation and removed fallback behavior as compatibility-sensitive even when the security rationale is strong.

options.title: Adopt the strict boundary
options.body: Land the rejection so widget-originated text remains conversational only and cannot request host command interpretation.

options.title: Preserve legacy widget prompts
options.body: Keep one or both prefixes available to widget prompts, accepting the resulting command-authority boundary and requiring a different mitigation.

recommendation.title: Adopt the strict boundary
recommendation.body: Land the rejection so widget-originated text remains conversational only and cannot request host command interpretation.

likelyOwner.reason: They introduced the current MCP App message bridge and have the clearest implementation context for its prompt-authority contract.
